newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: HIH Winterthur says 1997 numbers on track.
newsitem.headline: HIH Winterthur says 1997 numbers on track.

text.p: Insurance group HIH Winterthur International Holdings Ltd said on Thursday its 1997 performance remained on track, confirming its March forecast of a positive profit outlook and considerable premium growth.

"We are certainly expecting a good 1997, subject to the vagaries of investment markets, but as far as the business is concerned it is tracking well," chief executive Ray Williams told reporters after the company's annual meeting.

While declining to quantify the level of any increased overall profitablility, Williams said the double-digit premium growth the company was generating should be reflected in the underwriting profits.

"If you look at the growth in premium income, we think that should be mirrored in the underwriting profits for the group," he said, adding that recent acquisitions had provided substantial contributions to premium income.
"Some of that flows through of course from our acquisitions of Care America and also Colonial Mutual General, with those two operations alone adding premium income of some A$200 million."
While Winterthur remained on the lookout for acquisition possibilities, Williams said there was no significant purchases on the immediate horizon.

"We are constantly looking at acquisition possibilities. Our size tends to invite people to talk to us, so there are always discussions going on in various areas but I can tell there is nothing of major note at the moment."
By 12.10 p.m. (0210 GMT), Winterthur shares were steady at A$2.85 on turnover of 162,374 shares.
